name: How long does it take to design and install a custom cabana?

mainEntity.name: How long does it take to design and install a custom cabana?

acceptedAnswer.text: The timeline for designing and installing a custom cabana varies based on its complexity, size, material availability, and the permitting process. Typically, the design phase can take 3-6 weeks, followed by 4-12 weeks for permit approvals, depending on the municipality. Construction itself can range from 8-16 weeks. We provide a detailed project schedule upfront, outlining key milestones and estimated completion dates. Our goal is to complete your project efficiently while maintaining the highest standards of quality and craftsmanship.
acceptedAnswer.description: Design typically takes 3-6 weeks, permitting 4-12 weeks, and construction 8-16 weeks, depending on project scope and approvals.
